description: Local deterministic website-demo replies. No AI or SpicyChat API is used.

replies: “Hey,” {bot} replies. “This is just the local demo responder.”
{bot} gives a small nod. “Hi. Testing the chat?”
“Yep. The website is matching your text against a few local presets,” {bot} says. “No AI request is happening.”
“Lorebook,” {bot} repeats. “The demo keeps those entries local, but the page is there so QoL controls have something to work with.”
“Persona switch test?” {bot} asks. “The active demo persona only exists in this browser.”
{bot} tilts their head at the word dragon. “That one matched a demo keyword.”
{bot} goes still for a second at the mention of a raptor. “Keyword match. Local preset reply.”
{bot} glances toward the imaginary workbench. “Gearbox, engine, bike — those all use the same little demo rule.”
“Story state keyword detected,” {bot} says. “The real tracker still comes from QoL; this reply is only demo text.”
